_note: Accord ARTICLES — the standing structure of the law, and the baseline text a run starts with. Distinct from law-cards.json, which is the hand of amendments offered during a window. An article is a heading the Accord always has; a law card is a change to what it says.

articles.title: Access to the Record
articles._note: Bounded by the Core Mandate: cm-01 forbids unrestricted archive access outright, so amendments here have a ceiling the player cannot see the reason for.

articles.title: Succession and Appointment
articles._note: Contains the clause that lets the Board install an interim Mayor without an election — the legal mechanism Chapter 2 opens with. Written at founding, and nobody currently alive remembers why.

articles.title: Provision of Founder Stores
articles._note: THE seeded article. Unamendable, unremarkable, and it exempts 'founder-era stores' from audit — which is how the Presidium's catalyst shipments have gone unquestioned for generations. Finding this via Focus is the strongest form of the Chapter 1 catalyst thread.
